sentences.en: Check your blood glucose levels and if you are low, or feel a hypo coming on, eat a snack.

sentences.en: Hypoglycemia (also known as a hypo, insulin shock, and a low) is brought on by abnormally low levels of glucose in the blood (i.e., 70 mg/dl or less).
